items.stem: Copilot generates a deck with a headline growth figure. What is the correct next step before presenting?

options.text: Verify the figure against the source data
options.rationale: Correct: generated figures must be checked against trusted sources before use.

options.text: Present it immediately because the deck looks polished
options.rationale: Visual polish is not evidence of accuracy.

options.text: Add more slides to hide uncertainty
options.rationale: Adding slides does not resolve an unverified figure.
The source is needed for verification.

items.explanation: Correct: generated figures must be checked against trusted sources before use.

items.stem: Which TWO are good practices when using Copilot in PowerPoint? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Ground the deck in a trusted source document
options.rationale: Correct: grounding in trusted sources improves relevance of generated content.

options.text: Review each slide's figures before presenting
options.rationale: Correct: generated content must be reviewed for accuracy.

options.text: Assume the generated narrative order is always optimal
options.rationale: Generated structure often needs reordering for a coherent argument.

options.text: Ground on a confidential file regardless of sharing rules
options.rationale: Confidentiality and sharing rules must be respected.

items.explanation: Correct: grounding in trusted sources improves relevance of generated content.

items.stem: When is building slides manually preferable to using Copilot?

options.text: When the content is highly sensitive and every word must be author-controlled
options.rationale: Correct: tightly controlled, sensitive content can warrant manual authoring.

options.text: When you want a fast first draft to react to
options.rationale: That is a good case for Copilot assistance.

options.text: When converting a long document into a starter deck
options.rationale: That is a good case for Copilot assistance.

options.text: When you need rough speaker notes to edit
options.rationale: That is a reasonable assisted task.

items.explanation: Correct: tightly controlled, sensitive content can warrant manual authoring.
